credit.credit-words: Dear Lord and Father of Mankind
WORDS: John G. Whittier, 1872. MUSIC: “Rest”; Frederick C. Maker, 1887. Public Domain.

Go forth, and stand... before the Lord. And, behold.... a still small voice. 1 Ki. 19:11-12 Be still, and know that I am God. Psa. 46:10 Commit thy way unto the Lord; trust also in him. 37:5 Let us... enter into that rest. Heb. 4:11
